description: This file defines the interface DownstreamSenderFactory, which serves as a factory for creating clients to send data via Hono's southbound Telemetry and Event APIs. It includes method signatures for obtaining or creating sender instances for specified tenants, and a static method to instantiate the factory with an existing connection.

classes.name: DownstreamSenderFactory
classes.description: An interface defining factory methods for creating senders for telemetry and event APIs, including a static creation method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of DownstreamSenderFactory using an existing HonoConnection.

methods.name: getOrCreateTelemetrySender
methods.description: Returns a Future that completes with a sender for transmitting telemetry data for a specified tenant.

methods.name: getOrCreateEventSender
methods.description: Returns a Future that completes with a sender for transmitting event data for a specified tenant.
